# Althusser

*1918 – 1990 · French · [Marxism](../movements/marxism.md), [Structuralism](../movements/structuralism.md)*

French Marxist philosopher who offers an "anti-humanist" reading of [Marx](../philosophers/marx.md): history is a process without a subject, and individuals are constituted by ideological apparatuses.
